t: This is the Apollo Theatre on Shaftesbury Avenue, a Grade II listed West End theatre in the City of Westminster. It was designed by the architect Lewin Sharp for the owner, Henry Lowenfeld. It opened on the twenty-first of February 1901 with the American musical comedy The Belle of Bohemia, and it was the fourth legitimate theatre built on this street. Sharp was a British architect, and the theatre is the work of his that we know here.
